thought.text:
Session **konsisten** — 5 koneksi baru, IP sama (`187.14.254.183`). Jadi sticky berfungsi.

Tapi tadi browser dapat IP lain. Kemungkinan: **capbypass juga mengubah IP** saat solve. Solver capbypass memakai proxy yang sama, tapi mungkin koneksinya keluar dari IP berbeda, atau session Proxidize sudah expired.

Saya ukur langsung: solve sekali, lalu cek IP yang **capbypass** gunakan.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
import time
from capsolve import _post, KEY
S="ipsolve"+__import__("os").urandom(2).hex()
u=f"jPDZYa2fSH3jMmQN-s-{S}-co-US-type-residential"
pw="bHaUJVMb4cPlQZOL"
px_arg=f"pg.proxi.es:20000:{u}:{pw}"
# TurnstileTask membalas solution; sebagian solver punya field 'proxyInfo' / coba lihat isi lengkap
r=_post("/createTask",{"clientKey":KEY,"task":{
   "type":"TurnstileTask","websiteURL":"https://api.ipify.org","websiteKey":"0x4AAAAAAFoFe99_cOH0RnFT",
   "proxy":px_arg,"proxyType":"http"}})
print("create:",r)
tid=r.get("taskId")
for _ in range(40):
    time.sleep(4)
    g=_post("/getTaskResult",{"clientKey":KEY,"taskId":tid})
    if g.get("status")=="ready":
        print("solution:",__import__("json").dumps(g)[:400]); break
    if g.get("errorId"): print("err:",g); break
PY
